description: Empirical Lawhood 1.0.0 supplies a recursive workflow for defining investigations, contributing reusable methods and integrating scientific domains. It declares 22 preprint-inspired experiments with independent units, causal forecasts and a common format for retained results. The release evidence records which software checks and scientific studies have completed. Software uses MPL-2.0, project-authored documentation and figures use CC-BY-4.0, and project-generated evidence and data use CC0-1.0 unless a file states otherwise. Third-party material retains its own terms. The licensing guide identifies file scopes. Scientific archives have their own custody and access conditions. The associated preprint is a separate publication with DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23083988.
title: Empirical Lawhood
